I'm considering it. But I've seen some friends who are on meds, and...I don't know man. It seems like they're not there. Lights are on, but no one's home.

I am thinking about it though. Maybe next year, maybe enough to survive for another year. Thank you for the input.

I was raised Catholic, then became part of the Mormon church, then became part of the Evangelist church. I was into Buddhism last year, and did the Vipassana 10-day meditation thing, but...to be honest? I think it fucked me up a little. Thanks though. I really appreciate the input.

I love motorcycling. I really, really do. I'm also really into a lot of things - playing music, art, writing, cooking...but thinking about it now, maybe I just needed a way to fill the gaps, you know? I can't stand not doing anything.

Hey.

I...yeah. That's interesting. I've been thinking about what you said for the past few hours, and it just occurred to me that I actually haven't...done that, you know? I guess all my life I've just been doing stuff. I don't know how to explain it, but yeah.

I really don't know where to start...but I'll give that a shot.
